description: He wears an aubergine-purple long outer coat with narrow gold patterned trim along its standing collar, front edges, cuffs and hem. A cream linen-textured tunic with reddish-gold collar and lower-hem embroidery shows beneath it. Two small round metal clasps fasten the upper coat. A dark leather belt bears round gold fittings and a decorated hanging strap. Dark brown trousers tuck into brown calf-high leather boots. No crown, headwear, armor or weapons are visible.
